headline: Review of proposed Artificial Intelligence and Emerging Technologies Policy, plus recommendations for Sections J and K.
summary: The agenda includes review of a proposed policy on artificial intelligence and emerging technologies. It also includes review and approval of recommendations for Sections J and K, with changes.

Review and approval of recommendations for Section J
